text:
maria: FYI scheduling maintenance for rack-23 (apac-west1) Sat 02:00-03:30 UTC. Scope: NIC firmware update + rolling node reboots + kernel livepatch. Cohorted drains to avoid noisy neighbor spikes.

devon: What's the expected GPU capacity impact and which tenants are affected?

maria: Rack-23 = 6 nodes, 12 GPUs. We'll take cohorts of 2 nodes (4 GPUs) at a time; peak capacity dip ~20% for ~15-25m per cohort. Affected: tenant-zeta (soft-affinity), tenant-gamma (pinned), others best-effort.

ops-bot: Created INFRA-2019. Preflight checklist assigned. Reminder Thu 23:45 UTC.

shreyas: Recommend pre-warm of burst nodes in apac-west1 and eu-west1 for 20m before start. Also lower default batch_timeout_ms to 40ms during window to reduce latency tail.

anya: tenant-gamma requires KMS token verification if we move them to eu-west1. product-sre, can you triage permissions?

product-sre: Will validate KMS and identity path. If we do cross-region fallback we must rotate temporary creds and revert within 10m after restore. Need sign-off from security.

olivia: Quick cost calc: if tenant-zeta backs up to eu-west1 for 30m expect ~80 USD. If we redirect tenant-gamma add ~260 USD due to reserved capacity uplift + egress.

devon: Canary plan: cordon n23-01,n23-02 first. Drain non-critical pods, run perf probes (p95, queue depth, token rate) for 12m. If stable, continue next cohort. If p95>300ms for >8m, abort and roll back.

maria: Exact cohorts: [n23-01,n23-02], [n23-03,n23-04], [n23-05,n23-06]. We'll set kv-seed=false for cohorts 25m prior (prevent cold-cache thrash).

shreyas: Drain snippet for runbook:
```
kubectl cordon n23-01
kubectl drain n23-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=300
# run perf-probes.sh against endpoint /health/perf
```

anya: Also add a step to disable automated KV priming on the drain target else we saw request storms last patch.

maria: noted. ops: attach firmware image SHA256 and vendor notes to INFRA-2019.

ops-bot: Pager rule updated: alert @oncall if token-gen errors > 5/min or p95 > 300ms for >8m.

devon: Network note: we'll apply a transient egress route preference toward eu-west1 for non-dedicated traffic. Revert automatically after window end.

olivia: I'll draft tenant comms: start/end times, likely impact, canary + auto-fallback, and cost disclaimer. Target send 6 hours prior.

product-sre: Preflight checklist required: backups validated, KMS paths confirmed, rollback images available, runbook dry-run. Schedule 30m preflight Sat 01:15 UTC.

maria: Scheduling preflight 01:15 UTC. Ops will execute canary at 02:00 UTC. If any blocking issue, we'll abort and spin up a hot-spare GPU node.

shreyas: One last ask: confirm kernel-livepatch package hash and NIC firmware sha256 in ticket before pushing.

maria: Will attach both to INFRA-2019 and post final sign-off here once preflight green.

anya: :thumbsup: Ping me when preflight passes and I'll approve tenant-gamma temporary move if needed.

maria: TL;DR: Sat 02:00-03:30 UTC rack-23 rolling NIC firmware + kernel livepatch. Canary cohorts, KV priming disabled, cross-region fallback ready, preflight 01:15 UTC. INFRA-2019 links to runbook, hashes, and cost estimates.
